status_note: Covered by [apache/datafusion#26222](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/26222) (open), with the open PR #26784. Reproduces on 55.0.0.
summary: `SUM` and `AVG` of doubles over a sliding frame subtract the value that leaves the frame, so once an infinity is in the running sum it stays: the frames after it are `inf` (or NaN) though their values are finite.
repro: `select v, sum(v) over (order by i rows between 1 preceding and current row) from (values (1, 1e308), (2, 1e308), (3, 1.0), (4, 1.0)) t(i, v)` gives `1e308, inf, inf, inf`; the frames' sums are `1e308, inf, 1e308, 2.0`. `avg` gives `inf` likewise.
handling: `--write-datafusion` refuses `SUM` of doubles, `AVG` and `MIN` over a frame that does not start at `UNBOUNDED PRECEDING` (`Rel.slidingFrames`). Sliding `MIN` gave the right rows in these probes.
found_by: audit of DataFusion's limits on the shared path (2026-11-08)
